summary: STORE Capital LLC filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $589M aggregate principal amount of STORE Master Funding Net-Lease Mortgage Notes, Series 2026-1, by multiple wholly owned bankruptcy-remote subsidiaries. The offering comprised $567M Class A Notes sold to QIBs at fixed rates (5.22%-5.41%) and $22M Class B Notes retained by an affiliate. Proceeds will repay existing debt and fund growth. The placement is a routine secured-debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation: it involves no change of control, no shareholder vote, and no restructuring beyond ordinary refinancing.
